one_line: A dvarapandita of Nalanda, testing incoming students through fierce public debate in the great monastery-university of eastern India.

appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, sharp observant eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm default expression with a faint, knowing half-smile
appearance.hair: black hair tied into a small, tight topknot at the crown, sides smoothly oiled back, no shaven patch; simple narrow saffron headband wrapped around the base of the topknot
appearance.costume: era-accurate Buddhist monk’s attire: an inner light-cream cotton tunic with long sleeves and a modest round neckline over a full-length reddish-brown cotton dhoti tied at the waist, all covered by a large saffron-yellow kāṣāya robe draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the body, with an additional deep-maroon rectangular shawl folded over the left forearm; simple leather sandals, a plain wooden bead bracelet at one wrist, and no ornate jewellery.
appearance.signature: a long palm-leaf manuscript bundle bound with a red cord, held in his left hand, with one leaf slightly fanned open as if mid-debate

ref_desc: A lean early-30s Nalanda gate scholar with an oval medium-brown face, black topknot and saffron headband, wearing cream tunic, reddish-brown dhoti, saffron robe, maroon shawl, leather sandals, and holding a red-cord-bound palm-leaf manuscript bundle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style Nalanda gate scholar: lean man in his early thirties with an oval medium-brown face, sharp eyes, short beard and moustache, and black hair tied into a small topknot wrapped by a narrow saffron headband. He wears a light-cream long-sleeved cotton tunic, a full-length reddish-brown dhoti tied at the waist, and a large saffron-yellow Buddhist monk’s robe draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around his body, with a deep-maroon rectangular shawl folded neatly over his left forearm. His feet are in simple leather sandals, and a plain wooden bead bracelet circles one wrist. In his left hand he holds his signature prop: a long bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts bound tightly with a red cord, one leaf slightly fanned open as if ready to quote in debate. Use saffron yellow, deep maroon, reddish brown, cream, and medium brown as the dominant colours, and pose him upright and composed, as if standing by Nalanda’s entrance ready to test an aspiring student.
